scores.name: Instruction
scores.evidence: instruction pack version-pinned on every run.open; no lifecycle telemetry, so capped at 3

scores.name: Context delivery
scores.evidence: model.call declares inputs and window budget on every call; no per-input arrival telemetry

scores.name: Context management
scores.evidence: graph.query reports bytes_read against index_bytes, so retrieval cost is measured rather than asserted

scores.name: Tool interface
scores.evidence: tool.request carries a schema version on every call; no tool.register events on this ledger

scores.name: Execution environment
scores.evidence: every tool.request names a sandbox and an egress allowlist hash

scores.name: Durable state
scores.evidence: N/A: no telemetry for this primitive in this ledger

scores.name: Orchestration
scores.evidence: capability.run and approval both present; no rung earned by threshold in this window

scores.name: Sub-agents
scores.evidence: subagent.spawn declares the granted capability set and the broker gates on it

scores.name: Skills
scores.evidence: skill.resolve carries a verified signature state, never a title fallback

scores.name: Verification
scores.evidence: sensor.verdict carries a liveness-checked verdict; one sensor reported broken

scores.name: Observability
scores.evidence: signed head over every envelope; no ledger.anchor event, so the head is not anchored off-host

scores.name: Governance
scores.evidence: every policy.decision names a rule id; one run carries a non-empty authority.diverged
